timing: Compute Phoenix reported UTC order with explicit offsets; no path or common-object association, no speed. T1 conditional kinematic prediction v/c=sqrt(1+r^2), advance=L/c*(1-1/sqrt(1+r^2)), r=mu*c^2/E. Synthetic positive/negative controls only. For real event require authenticated common emission/arrival, known path lower bound, calibrated relative clocks and uncertainties, measured signal-front, independent carrier-specific response; otherwise HOLD. Two receive times cannot alone establish emission time. Do not convert object speed to carrier speed. No carrier attribution even when timing conflict candidate exists.
